locator: Global Witness, 25 November 2025, sections « Liberian cocoa goes global » and « Blended deforestation », especially paragraphs on Nestlé's response
summary: Global Witness maps Liberian cocoa exports through traders and processors supplying major chocolate companies. It states that Nestlé does not source directly from Liberia, but uses mass-balance cocoa systems in which beans from different origins can be mixed. Nestlé told the investigators it was aware of the broader risk; when asked how it could rule out Liberian beans entering its mass-balance supply chain, it declined to provide further information.
limitations: The investigation identifies supply-chain exposure and a traceability risk, not direct Nestlé purchases from Liberia or proof that a particular Nestlé product contains cocoa from a deforested farm.
